what: Vertically stacked picture cells grow the closer they are to the screen’s focus line (height 34%). If a cell’s anchor (top edge + 12% of height) is above the focus it is 1x, and as it gets farther below by (screen − focus) × .72 it shrinks down to .28x (eased by 1 − (1 − t)^1.65), with width, height and opacity (.35 + size × .65) changing together. Cells sit flush right, forming a staircase where small cells rise and grow as you scroll down. Values follow at 16% per frame. When the cell nearest the focus changes, it emits fx:focus(detail.index) so the side list lights up its row.

options.falloff: Range that shrinks below the focus (multiple of (screen − focus)), default .72
options.lerp: Share followed each frame, default .16 (1 means instant)
options.base: Full height of the cell (em), default 52
options.side: Side the cells attach to — right (default)·left
options.fx:focus: Event fired from the element when the focus cell changes (bubbles) — detail.index · detail.item

from.where: works.html .wk-item (image cell on the right of the work list — focus .34 · .28→1x · the active row of the pinned left list follows along)
